data.long_meaning: In the Hebrew Bible, Rebekkah is the name of the wife of Isaac and mother of Jacob and Esau. The name Rebekkah comes from the Hebrew word "rekevet", meaning 'to tie, to bind'. It can also be translated as 'servant of God'. In the biblical story, Rebekkah was chosen by God to be the wife of Isaac, and she played a significant role in the lives of her two sons, Jacob and Esau. Rebekkah's story is a powerful reminder of the importance of faith, obedience, and the role of God in our lives.
